versions.content: After preparation for a power state is achieved by API Adc_PreparePowertState then the API Adc_SetPowerState shall be used to achieve the requested power state of the ADC module. In order to avoid incoherent power state conditions, some APIs (Adc_SetPowerState, Adc_PreparePowerState) have to be called in a given sequence, otherwise an error (if DET tracing is enabled) is stored and the action is interrupted. The ADC Driver keeps track of the call sequence.
